title: Credit and Collections Policy: Crediting an Excess Down Payment to Payment Arrangements
content:
**Credit and Collections Policy — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): excess down payment credited against the arranged amount**

**Clause.** The part of the excess down payment credited against the arranged amount follows the payment record of the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account over the twelve months ending on the acceptance day:

(a) where no late payment charge was billed and no returned payment was posted in those twelve months, 100 percent (1.0) of the excess is credited;

(b) where one or two late payment charges but no returned payment were, 50 percent (0.5) of it is credited;

(c) otherwise none of it is credited.

**Truth table**

| Late payment charges billed in the twelve months | Returned payments posted in the twelve months | Share of the excess credited |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 100 percent |
| 1 | 0 | 50 percent |
| 2 | 0 | 50 percent |
| 3 or more | 0 | none |
| any number | 1 or more | none |

**Hypothetical:** an excess of $36.00 is credited as $36.00 on an account with a clean twelve months, as $18.00 on an account with two late payment charges and no return, and not at all on an account with one returned payment.
